Annotate alignment table with compound names by spectral library screening

annotate_grouped.Rd

Using the SQLite spectral library (CSL), this function will pass over the alignment table, open the measurement files stored in datenList and compare m/z, retention time and MS² spectra found in the data and the library.

Usage 

annotate_grouped(
  sampleListLocal,
  peakListList,
  alignmentTable,
  db_path,
  threshold_score = 500,
  mztolu = 0.005,
  rttol = 1,
  polarity = "pos",
  CE = c(30, 40),
  CES = c(0, 15),
  instrument = c("LC-ESI-QTOF TripleTOF 5600 SCIEX", "LC-ESI-QTOF TripleTOF 6600 SCIEX",
    "LC-ESI-Orbitrap QExactive Thermo", "LC-ESI-QTOF Agilent 6500 Series Q-TOF",
    "LC-ESI-QTOF TripleTOF X500R SCIEX", "LC-ESI-QTOF ZenoTOF 7600 SCIEX",
    "LC-ESI-Orbitrap Exploris 240 Thermo"),
  chrom_method = "bfg_nts_rp1",
  ndp_m = 2,
  ndp_n = 1,
  mztolu_ms2 = 0.015,
  rtoffset = 0,
  intCutData = 0,
  numcores = 1,
  datenListLocal,
  expGroups = "bfg"
)

Arguments

peakListList

list of data.frames of the peak-lists

alignmentTable

Knonw as "grouped" in the app

db_path

Path to the spectral library (CSL in SQLite format)

threshold_score

dot product threshold score

mztolu

m/z tolerance in Da

rttol

RT tolerance in min.

polarity

Polarity of the measurement

CE

Collision energy

CES

Collision energy spread

instrument

Instruments allowed, must match the instruments listed in the library

chrom_method

Chromatography name to choose the correct retention times from the library

ndp_m

Peak intensity weighting factor for dot-product

ndp_n

m/z weighting factor for dot-product

mztolu_ms2

m/z window for dot-product

rtoffset

Offset the database to make it match your values (in min)

intCutData

Cut off intensity under which fragments are ignored (in data spectra)

numcores

Number of cores for parallelization (currently not used)

sampleList

data.frame of filenames and paths

Value

`data.frame` with the annotations for the alignment table referenced by the column "alignementID" (compound identifiers and results of the spectral comparison)

Details

This function operates either in conjunction with the non-target app but can also work in stand-alone scripts, see examples in ntsportal. If data files are not in memory (xcmsRaw objects), they will be temporary loaded. `datenListLocal` is a shallow copy. Therefore, changes to the underlying xcmsRaw objects affect the calling environment.

## Spectral library The spectral library is an SQLite file (see Jewell et al. 2019).

## References Jewell, K. S., Kunkel, U., Ehlig, B., Thron, F., Schlüsener, M., Dietrich, C., . . . Ternes, T. A. (2019). Comparing mass, retention time and MS2 spectra as criteria for the automated screening of small molecules in aqueous environmental samples analyzed by LC-QToF-MS/MS. Rapid Communications in Mass Spectrometry, 34, e8541. doi:10.1002/rcm.8541
